name: Nitropage
description: Nitropage is an extensible, visual website builder, offering a growing library of versatile building blocks, focal-point image cropping and sovereign font management.
composeYaml:
services:
  nitropage:
    image: 'nitropage/nitropage:sqlite'
    environment:
      - 'NP_AUTH_SALT=${SALT_SECRET}'
      - 'NP_AUTH_PASSWORD=${SESSION_PASSWORD}'
      - 'DATABASE_URL=file:../.data/dev.db'
    volumes:
      - 'nitropage-data:/app/.data'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - '-f'
        - 'http://127.0.0.1:3000/admin'
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 15
